如果不加控制，过剩的输出可能会损坏关键的引擎部件。我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]建议了几种可能的对策：排放多余的等离子体以稳定系统，重新分配工作任务优先级，或者暂时关闭引擎进行全面重新校准。
texts.en:
A sudden engine surge aboard [Root.GetName] has pushed the Arkship's drive core beyond safe operating tolerances. Heat blooms are spreading through the primary engine assembly, and pressure is rising faster than the regulation systems can compensate.

If left unchecked, the excess output could damage critical engine components. Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] recommend several possible responses: vent the excess plasma to stabilize the system, reprioritize work assignments, or temporarily shut the engines down to conduct a full recalibration.

tooltips.zh: 这将改善旅客满意度，但是会恶化船员压力水平。

label.en: Shut the engines down and recalibrate.

texts.zh:
多余的等离子体已通过受控排放排出，在方舟舰的舰艉洒下灿烂的光幕。引擎压力已恢复至正常水平，未记录到永久性损伤。

不过，此次排放留下了一层宝贵的带电粒子残余物，其中大部分已被成功回收并汇入我们的储备。
texts.en:
The excess plasma was vented in a controlled discharge, spilling brilliant sheets of light across the Arkship's stern. Engine pressure has returned to acceptable levels, and no lasting damage was recorded.

The release did, however, leave behind a valuable residue of energized particles, much of which has been successfully recovered and routed into our reserves.

texts.zh:
在过去的六个月里，[Root.GetName]上的维修人员马不停蹄地工作，力求让方舟舰过热的驱动系统恢复控制。在引擎持续运行的情况下，他们拆除了检修面板，重新布置了冷却管线，并更换了受损的调节器。

这些努力目前已经稳定了驱动核心，负责这项工作的船员们为此忍受了长时间的轮班和恶劣的工作环境。尽管疲惫不堪，但士气依然高涨。无论虚空给我们将带来什么，我们都有信心能够承受。
texts.en:
For the past six months, repair crews on [Root.GetName] have worked without pause to bring the Arkship's overheating drive systems back under control. Access panels were stripped away, coolant lines rerouted, and damaged regulators replaced while the engines continued to run.

The effort has stabilized the drive core for now, though the crews responsible endured long shifts and harsh working conditions to make it happen. Despite their exhaustion, morale is high. Whatever the void throws at us, we are confident we can endure it.

texts.zh:
在过去的六个月里，维护子个体在不间断地运行，以使方舟舰过热的驱动系统恢复控制。在发动机持续运转的情况下，检修面板被拆除，冷却液管道被重新布线，受损的调节器也得到了更换。

虽然该行动需要子个体在多个系统子模块中持续作业，但这一过程也揭示了发动机组件中的几处结构性缺陷。这些问题现已得到修正，整体运行效率有了显著提升。无论虚空带来怎样的压力，我们都将适应。
texts.en:
For the past six months, maintenance drones have operated without interruption to bring the Arkship's overheating drive systems back under control. Access panels were removed, coolant conduits rerouted, and damaged regulators replaced while the engines continued to run.

Though the operation required sustained drone activity across multiple subsystems, the process revealed several structural inefficiencies in the engine assembly. These have now been corrected, and overall operational efficiency has measurably improved. Whatever stresses the void may impose, we will adapt.

texts.zh:
发动机按受控阶段逐步关停，以便我们的工程师在安全条件下检查驱动组件并重新校准其调节系统。虽然这一过程延误了行程，但关停期间收集的数据已证明具有重要价值。

我们已查明[Root.GetName]核心定序中的几处效率低下问题。通过重定向多余能量并加固结构支撑，我们增强了方舟舰的护盾与船壳，使其足以抵御未来的压力。
texts.en:
The engines were brought down in controlled stages, allowing our engineers to inspect the drive assembly under safe conditions and recalibrate its regulation systems. The process delayed us, but the data gathered during the shutdown has already proven valuable.

Several inefficiencies in the core sequencing on [Root.GetName] have been identified. By redirecting surplus energy and reinforcing structural supports, our we have strengthened both the Arkship's shields and hull against future strain.

# 面临压力 / Under Pressure

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nomads_arkship_events.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt、common/special_projects/06_projects_nomads.txt、common/event_chains/00_event_chains_nomads.txt · 游牧帝国内容 nomad content · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国的方舟随机事件：隐藏事件 arkship.1（nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49）定期检查，游戏前5年不会发生，每次约三分之一几率（中期前×1.5；近期参战或所有方舟都在战斗时为0）调用 generate_arkship_event 从 mobile_arkship_random_events 池（00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006，24项，总权重460）中抽取一件，否则3–5年后再试。多数事件设置一次性标记（个别如“出发！”可发生两次）；结束后约10–15年再重新开始检查。（池中权重 10/460，00_on_actions.txt:3985）
Nomad arkship random event: hidden arkship.1 (nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49) checks periodically — never in the first 5 years, about one in three (×1.5 before mid game, 0 during recent war or when every arkship is fighting) — and draws one episode from mobile_arkship_random_events (00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006, 24 entries, total weight 460); otherwise it retries in 3–5 years. Most episodes set a once-only flag (Start Your Engines can happen twice); after it ends the loop resumes roughly 10–15 years later. (pool weight 10/460, 00_on_actions.txt:3985)

条件：本国尚未发生“面临压力”“中轴的裂纹”或“摇摇欲坠的核心”。
Conditions: none of Under Pressure / Spinal Fracture / A Faltering Core has happened.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 引擎浪涌使驱动核心超出安全范围：排放等离子 →180–210天后“释放压力”；加紧抢修 →180天后“加班报告”；停机校准 →360天后“重新校准引擎核心”。
  An engine surge: vent plasma → Pressure Released (180–210 days), redouble efforts → Overtime Reporting (180 days), or shut down and recalibrate → Recalibrated Drive Core (360 days).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 三种处理方式各有一个结果；与另外两件引擎故障事件互斥。
  Each choice has its own outcome; exclusive with the other two engine-trouble episodes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊差异。
  No notable variants.
